name: os_menu
description: Open or close the Albie menu, where the user finds their tools, projects and artifacts. Without open it toggles.

open.description: true opens the menu, false closes it

name: os_tab
description: Show one tab of the Albie menu (opens the menu if it is closed): tools, projects or artifacts. The projects tab shows a New project tile (Build something) and the user's own projects first, then four samples (worked examples to look around).

name: os_open
description: Open something from the Albie menu by kind and id. Tool ids: cad, code, train, notebook, drive, messages, gestures, agents (crew and Project workflow). Projects: an id (the sample projects proj_truck, proj_quadcopter, proj_rocket, proj_classifier, or one of the user's own) or a name or alias as said (drone, quadcopter, rocket, truck, classifier, a project's title); for 'open the drone project' prefer project_open, which also answers with the project's next step to offer. System pages: agents, settings, build (Build something: the one way to start a project of the user's own), workflow (coding plan, 3D crew progress, diff, checks and pull request). Works at the desk and away from it. Returns an error if there is no such thing.

id.description: the id of the tool, project, artifact or system page

name: os_windows
description: Manage the user's open windows. recenter brings every window back in front of the user, side by side. close_all closes them all.
